lead.title: Founder & Digital Product Developer — apollo::rio (Nov 2024–Present)
lead.body: Designed and developed a user-centred digital platform for Rio de Janeiro’s cultural and creative ecosystem, owning product roadmap and delivery across digital experience, user journeys, onboarding and self-service flows, UX/UI, WordPress/CMS services, APIs, structured data, automation, role-based access, documentation and iterative releases. Built integrated workflows for event discovery, user services and community features; evaluated technology options, dependencies, implementation effort, risks and value trade-offs; and applied privacy-by-design, accessibility, mobile-first and AI-assisted development principles to improve usability, autonomy and operational efficiency.

entries.role: Marine Operations Superintendent (Projects, Performance & Stakeholder Coordination)
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder project execution across vessels, clients, terminals, suppliers, contractors and international management, coordinating resources, priorities, dependencies, risks and operational deliverables.

Acted as a business-facing bridge between field teams and management, translating operational needs into practical plans, procedures, decisions and follow-up actions across distributed multinational teams.
Produced management reports, forecasts and KPI analyses covering production, availability, downtime, fuel, costs and operational deviations, supporting data-driven decisions and recovery actions.

Supported change implementation through procedures, briefings, alignment meetings, lessons learned, corrective actions and continuous-improvement initiatives, strengthening readiness and adoption of new ways of working.
Coordinated vendors and service providers, supported negotiations and monitored delivery quality, schedule, interfaces and operational requirements.

entries.role: Operations Analyst (Process Improvement, Digital Workflows & Offshore Support)
bullets: Mapped and formalised internal processes, created procedures and document-control practices, and supported the company’s preparation for ISO 9001 implementation, improving standardisation, traceability and readiness for external review.

Conceived the functional architecture of an internal operational-integration solution connecting Warehouse, HR, Finance, invoicing and operational documentation, simplifying access to information and reducing workflow fragmentation.
Managed operational information and compliance workflows in Petrobras Drake / SAP RT, including documentation, qualification matrices, personnel readiness and logistics data.
Produced DPR/RDO reports, monitored indicators, deliverables and deviations, and coordinated crews, materials, suppliers and offshore-service readiness for FPSO/OSV campaigns.
Supported digital records, logistics workflows, documentation control and operational mobilisation for offshore clients, including qualification and credentialing data in Petrobras systems.
Delivered structured training to multinational offshore teams, translating SOPs and creating practical learning materials for operational, safety and emergency communication.
Supported end users through direct instruction, coaching and contextual learning, adapting content to different proficiency levels and reinforcing confidence, autonomy and adoption.
International engineering research involving structured data collection, technical analysis, testing support and multidisciplinary collaboration.
